subject.title: memory_search: chokidar file watcher silently stops delivering events, index goes stale

question: Should unconfigured memory_search users get a default periodic sync fallback, or should periodic sync remain opt-in with docs/doctor guidance?
rationale: The narrow technical fix is clear, but changing intervalMinutes from disabled to default-on can add background scans and provider/indexing work for existing users, which is a product and upgrade-safety choice.

options.title: Default fallback after PR repair
options.body: Accept a default periodic fallback once the linked PR scopes dirty marking correctly and preserves explicit intervalMinutes: 0 as the opt-out.

options.title: Keep periodic sync opt-in
options.body: Leave the shipped default at 0 and document or doctor-suggest intervalMinutes for users who need watcher resilience.

options.title: Split health logging from default change
options.body: Merge watcher health/error improvements separately and defer the default interval choice to a follow-up decision.

recommendation.title: Default fallback after PR repair
recommendation.body: Accept a default periodic fallback once the linked PR scopes dirty marking correctly and preserves explicit intervalMinutes: 0 as the opt-out.
